explanation: The DOI resolves to a real 2025 Nature Communications paper with a very similar title, but the actual paper is titled with "vertebrate oocytes" and has a different author list. Because the DOI/year and core topic match but key citation metadata is wrong, this is partially valid rather than fully valid.
mismatches: title: claimed "Translational repression by 4E-T is crucial to maintain the prophase-I arrest in mouse oocytes", actual "Translational repression by 4E-T is crucial to maintain the prophase-I arrest in vertebrate oocytes"
authors: claimed Heim, Tolmachova, Raina, Zigáčková, Baumgarten, Schoof et al.; actual Heim, Cheng, Orth, Stengel, Schuh, Mayer
search_attempts: web searched: "Translational repression by 4E-T is crucial to maintain the prophase-I arrest in mouse oocytes"
web searched: "Translational repression by 4E-T is crucial to maintain the prophase-I arrest in vertebrate oocytes"
